metric.community_public_knowledge_availa.limitations: Subreddit member counts and Stack Overflow view/comment intensity are raw popularity-style proxies; per methodology they are used only as one declared line of evidence among four distinct channel types, not as the sole basis for the score. | CppCon attendance figures are in-person counts only and do not capture the much larger online video audience or the separate C++ Day / Meeting C++ regional conferences, so the true public-conference reach is understated by this single figure. | Exact current Stack Overflow question-count-per-tag could not be retrieved from a live tag page in this pass; the evidence instead relies on secondary analyses confirming C++'s outsized engagement (views/comments) relative to other tags.
metric.community_public_knowledge_availa.selection_rule: Inspect the same knowledge channels for every language and use current, publicly accessible evidence rather than raw search-result counts alone.
